about.title: About the Legends Awakened set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Legends Awakened is a Diamond & Pearl expansion released on 1 August 2008. It has 146 cards: 146 in the main set and 0 secret rares. There are also 138 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 146 main set cards) or the Master set (284 cards, adding the reverse holos).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
